title: Bengali Foundations
review_note: Greetings are cross-checked against CBSE Bhasha Sangam. Other units are authored drafts awaiting native-speaker review. None are imported into reviewed translation memory.

units.title: 1 · First conversations
units.note: Use আপনি for respectful address. Roman spellings are pronunciation aids, not a single official spelling standard.

units.title: 2 · Polite exchanges
units.note: Keep requests polite. এই and সেটা point to things near and farther away respectively; this unit focuses on short set phrases.

units.title: 3 · Learning together
units.note: আমি means I. Bengali verbs carry person and politeness information; these examples use common learner requests.

units.title: 4 · Daily needs
units.note: চাই expresses wanting; ভালো লাগে expresses liking. জল and পানি are both used for water, with regional preferences.

units.title: 5 · Getting around
units.note: কোথায় asks where; কত asks how much. যাবেন is a respectful future form for you.

units.title: 6 · About yourself
units.note: আমার means my. Bengali present-tense noun statements often omit an explicit equivalent of English am/is/are.

items.native: আপনার সঙ্গে দেখা হয়ে ভালো লাগল।
items.roman: apnar shonge dekha hoye bhalo laglo
items.english: It was nice to meet you.
